label: Search for apps, settings, and documents
Feedback on recommendation
reason: Sends feedback to Microsoft's recommendation service, which Impossible OS does not have.

label: Type to search
behaviour: Typing with Start open moves the text into the search box and opens search.

label: Drag to reorder
behaviour: Dragging a pinned tile moves it; the others close up around it.

label: Drag onto a tile
behaviour: Dropping a pinned tile on another makes a folder of the two; a folder opens in place with its own grid and a name box.

label: Drag to the taskbar
behaviour: Dragging a pinned tile onto the taskbar pins it there as well.

label: Keyboard between regions
behaviour: Tab moves between the search box, the pinned grid, recommended, all apps and the bottom bar; arrows move within one.

label: Drag out to unpin
behaviour: No drag unpins a tile: a tile dragged out of the grid returns to its place, and Unpin from Start is the tile menu's entry.

label: Recommended with nothing to show
behaviour: With every Recommended switch off and Start restarted, the region still holds Get Started: this build has no empty Recommended state.

label: Making a folder
behaviour: Create a new app folder on a tile's menu turns that tile into a folder named after it ("Folder with Settings"); a click opens it over Start.

label: Closing
behaviour: Esc, the Windows key, or a click outside closes Start.

label: Back from the letter grid
behaviour: Back, or choosing a letter, returns from the letter grid to the list at that letter; letters with no apps are dimmed.

label: Gap between the panel and the taskbar
Panel left edge, taskbar aligned left
App tile width (pinned and grid view)
Pinned grid rows before Show all
All pinned apps
behaviour: Show all pinned apps grows the pinned grid in place to every pinned app; the columns stay the same.

label: Category view
behaviour: The All region in category view: the default: apps in category tiles of up to four icons.

label: Grid view
behaviour: The All region in grid view: apps as tiles under letter headings; a letter heading opens the letter grid.

label: List view
behaviour: The All region in list view: apps as one row each under letter headings; a letter heading opens the letter grid.

label: All apps
behaviour: Every app Start lists, in the list view's order; a folder's apps follow it.
